verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users converse with Copilot to search/browse code, ask questions about repos, assign issues to Copilot for automated PR generation, and review/approve/merge PRs conversationally, but there's no evidence of direct conversational edit/commit/pull/push actions inside the mobile app itself. missing for 10: evidence of an agent directly editing files, committing, pulling, and pushing via conversation (not just assigning tasks/reviewing), and independent corroboration of these agentic workflows beyond first-party marketing copy.
